title: Equipment cabinet
use_case: Field maintenance on an equipment cabinet: turn the quarter-turn latch to unlock the door, swing the door open, turn the valve handwheel inside a quarter turn (90 degrees) to open it, then plug the 8 mm round test connector into the service port.
headline: A tool-change sequence completes the task in 4 of 8 runs; the best single off-the-shelf tool in 0 of 8 runs.

plan.title: Cabinet maintenance
plan.description: Unlock a quarter-turn latch, swing open a cabinet door, open a handwheel valve by a quarter turn, and insert an 8 mm test connector into a service port.
layout_moves: Moved test_port from (0, -150) to (0, -240) mm to clear the swing of cabinet_door
assumptions: The latch requires about 0.5 N·m to turn and has a wing head 20 mm diameter.
The cabinet door is 400 mm tall, 200 mm deep, hinged on the left edge with a handle 20 mm from the front.
The service valve needs roughly 2 N·m to turn and has a 100 mm rim handwheel.
The test port socket accepts an 8 mm plug with 0.2 mm clearance and 1 mm chamfer.
Moved test_port from (0, -150) to (0, -240) mm to clear the swing of cabinet_door

steps.description: Turn the quarter-turn latch counter‑clockwise to unlock the door.
caveats: Latches are an approximation: a detent torque on a revolute joint; no cam or spring geometry.

steps.description: Hook the door handle and pull the door open.
Turn the handwheel valve counter‑clockwise a quarter turn to open it.
caveats: Valves are an approximation: a resistive torque curve on a revolute joint; no packing or seat dynamics.

steps.description: Insert the 8 mm test connector into the service port.
